# Date range picker (`date-range-picker`)

Calendar for a start and end date.

Group: Pickers. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/pickers';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createDateRangePicker` (types in `dist/web/pickers/dateRangePicker.d.ts`): `.mh-date-range-picker`: a `.mh-picker-trigger` button that opens a popover with one or more month grids in range mode: the first press picks the start, the second the end (in either order), and the popover closes. A status line says what to pick next; optional presets sit beside the calendar.

```ts
export function createDateRangePicker(options: DateRangePickerOptions = {}): DateRangePickerHandle;

export interface DateRangePickerOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the picker then renders the button alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: CompleteDateRange | null;
  /** Shown while nothing is picked (default "Choose dates"). */
  placeholder?: string;
  min?: IsoDate | null;
  max?: IsoDate | null;
  isDateDisabled?: (date: IsoDate) => boolean;
  locale?: string;
  weekStartsOn?: Weekday;
  /** Months side by side in the popover (default 2; one on narrow screens is up to the caller). */
  months?: number;
  /** Quick choices beside the calendar, e.g. "Last 7 days". */
  presets?: readonly DateRangePreset[];
  /** How each end is written on the button (default the locale's medium date). */
  format?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions;
  /** Adds a Clear button to the popover. */
  clearable?: boolean;
  /** Submits `<name>-start` and `<name>-end` with forms through hidden inputs. */
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  disabled?: boolean;
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  onChange?: (value: CompleteDateRange | null) => void;
}

export interface DateRangePickerHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  trigger: HTMLButtonElement;
  calendar: CalendarHandle;
  popover: PickerPopoverHandle;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): CompleteDateRange | null;
  setValue(value: CompleteDateRange | null): void;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface CalendarHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getValue(): IsoDate | null;
  setValue(value: IsoDate | null): void;
  getRange(): DateRange | null;
  setRange(range: DateRange | null): void;
  /** Shows the month holding `date` (and moves the keyboard focus date there). */
  showMonth(date: IsoDate): void;
  /** Moves keyboard focus to the active day. */
  focus(): void;
}

export interface PickerPopoverHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  open(): void;
  /** Closes; `refocus` returns focus to the anchor (default true). */
  close(refocus?: boolean): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  /** Re-anchors after the content changed size. */
  reposition(): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createDateRangePicker, pickerDates } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const today = pickerDates.todayIso();
const status = document.createElement('p');

const away = createDateRangePicker({
  label: 'Away from home',
  min: today,
  clearable: true,
  presets: [
    { label: 'Next 7 days', range: { start: today, end: pickerDates.addDays(today, 6) } },
    { label: 'Next 14 days', range: { start: today, end: pickerDates.addDays(today, 13) } },
  ],
  helper: 'The house runs in away mode on these days.',
  onChange: (range) => {
    status.textContent = range ? pickerDates.formatDateRange(range.start, range.end) : 'Not away.';
  },
});

document.body.append(away.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { DateRangePicker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { pickerDates, type CompleteDateRange } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function DateRangePickerExample() {
  const [today] = useState(() => pickerDates.todayIso());
  const [away, setAway] = useState<CompleteDateRange | null>(null);
  return (
    <DateRangePicker
      label="Away from home"
      min={today}
      clearable
      presets={[
        { label: 'Next 7 days', range: { start: today, end: pickerDates.addDays(today, 6) } },
        { label: 'Next 14 days', range: { start: today, end: pickerDates.addDays(today, 13) } },
      ]}
      helper="The house runs in away mode on these days."
      value={away}
      onChange={setAway}
    />
  );
}
```
